checklist.item: Chooses a stack and a place to host it, and says why.
Keeps a seat from being sold twice when two people book it at the same moment.
Releases a held seat once its hold runs out, without a person stepping in.
Gives each booking a reference a person can type to look it up later.
Books every passenger in a party together, so a party is never left half booked.
